text:
anya_sales: Heads-up — Acme renewal conversation today. They're asking for a 25% uplift vs current committed rate and want to add a 30M token POC window during the renewal quarter. I'm worried the rate math + short notice will need deal desk sign-off.
kevin_se: Do we have current usage baseline? If the POC is 30M tokens only for 3 months it might be handled as a transient burst, not a commit change.
anya_sales: They were at ~18M/mo historically. New ask is commit increase to 50M/mo for 12 months but with that 30M POC in month 1.
olivia_csm: Customer wants SSO + IP allowlist before the POC. Security questionnaire flagged by Matt yesterday is still open on Q3 (data residency). That will block private endpoints for the POC.
matt_security: Correct — security Q3 about data egress needs legal review. We can enable VPC peering for the POC but legal needs to sign the addendum. ETA ~3 business days if no other edits.
anya_sales: Ok — escalation plan: need deal desk approval on the uplift discount and a temporary POC access plan that doesn't require full private deployment. Jamie, can you weigh in on price exception?
jamie_dealdesk: Quick read: a standard uplift in this band requires a commercial exception. We can approve an interim 10% promotional uplift for the first quarter if sales takes a 6% concession on the annual commit. For anything >15% we need manager sign-off and revenue ops sign-off.
kevin_se: Can we propose this structure to Acme: keep annual commit flat at 50M/mo, apply a 10% promotional uplift credit for months 1-3 to cover the POC, and revisit rate for months 4+ if usage stabilizes? That avoids a long-term discount.
anya_sales: That matches what I was thinking. Need the exact numbers to show finance. Can someone quickly calc monthly $ impact?
kevin_se: Quick calc: list rate = $0.10/token. At 50M/mo that's $5,000,000/mo? wait typo — sorry math brainfart.
kevin_se: Correct math: 50M tokens * $0.0001 per token = $5,000/mo. With 10% promo credit month 1-3 => customer pays $4,500/mo for those months. Annualized effective rate = ((3*$4,500)+(9*$5,000))/12 = $4,875/mo.
anya_sales: Nice, concise. Can we call out worst-case revenue delta if we had to grant 15% uplift on the full year?
jamie_dealdesk: 15% off full-year would give effective monthly $4,250 -> annual run-rate delta from $5,000 to $4,250 = $9,000 loss vs list across 12 months. Need CRO approval for that level.
olivia_csm: Also flag: the POC access plan should include a hard token cap and a temporary API key with read-only telemetry access. We can disable after the POC. That reduces operational risk.
matt_security: Agree. If we can't do VPC in time, we can stand up a short-lived dedicated sandbox in our hosted environment with extra logging and IP lock. Legal addendum still required for data residency.
anya_sales: Action items: 1) Jamie — start deal desk exception for 10% promo and note escalation path for >15% (due EOD). 2) Matt — try to get legal sign-off ETA 72 hours for addendum. 3) Kevin/Olivia — draft POC access plan with token cap and SSO fallback. I'll send the customer a proposed commercial structure.
jamie_dealdesk: On it. I'll ping revenue-ops and attach a POA by 5pm PST. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: POC sandbox provisioning template created -> infra ticket #INF-3481 (owner: kevin_se)
kevin_se: I'll take INF-3481, prepping sandbox and the temporary API key flow. ETA 48 hours.
anya_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll share the proposal with Acme and loop back here after their reply. :eyes:
